description: This file contains unit tests for the ProgramWorkflowDAO class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing CRUD operations and retrieval methods related to Program entities and patient program lists.

classes.name: ProgramWorkflowDAOTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing ProgramWorkflowDAO operations in the OpenMRS context.

methods.name: runBeforeEachTest
methods.description: Initializes the DAO object by fetching it from the Spring application context before each test.

methods.name: saveProgram_shouldSaveProgram
methods.description: Tests that a Program can be successfully saved using the DAO.

methods.name: createProgram
methods.description: Helper method to instantiate and initialize a new Program object.

methods.name: saveProgram_shouldAlsoSaveOutcomesConcept
methods.description: Tests that saving a Program with an associated outcomesConcept persists both correctly.

methods.name: getProgramsByName_whenThereAreNoProgramsWithTheGivenName_shouldReturnAnEmptyList
methods.description: Verifies that querying by a non-existent name returns an empty list.

methods.name: getProgramsByName_whenThereAreProgramsWithTheGivenName_shouldReturnAllProgramsWithTheGivenName
methods.description: Verifies that querying by a specific name returns all matching Program entities.

methods.name: getPatientPrograms_shouldReturnListChronologicallySortedByEnrollmentDate
methods.description: Ensures that the list of PatientProgram objects returned is sorted by enrollment date.
